name: uberasm-airjump-and-airspin
title: Airjump and Airspin
description:
Allows the player to jump in the air. You can also make it limited so that after a number of jumps in a row gets disabled (not the buttons, in case if something also uses the jump button).

Also includes a NSMBW styled airspin move that allows the player to do a short spin in midair (by pressing spinjump, much like shaking the wii remote)
